title: Validate receiving plan masterdata and live lifecycle permissions
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing receiving-plan operators must resolve live enabled user and actual receiving-plan menu on all list/detail/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete operations. Preserve existing authoritative data-scope rules; where supplier plans have no authoritative salesperson ownership, restricted unmapped identities cannot be assigned global access. Fail before counts/number generation/writes. SupplierId must be positive/live/enabled, optional PortId valid under existing masterdata status, quantity positive for submission/approval, valid container enum and bounded normalized strings.

Validate complete proposed edit before assigning tracked fields; rejected supplier/quantity/port/state changes leave stored plan/status untouched. Serialize inherited state transitions with the same plan row lock and transaction, ensure duplicate approval/delete/cancel races cannot create inconsistent state. Preserve BookingNo as explicit legacy text, never infer booking links from numbers or pretend plan approval is receipt/inventory/shipment. Keep audit and source snapshot evidence. Test actual controllers with genuine menu identities, revoked access, invalid masterdata, zero/negative quantities, atomic failed edit and two-connection status races.
